phase: Phase 6 - Player Character & Alt-Roster Progression Analyzer, Ignition Sequence & 70/30 AH Liquidity Engine (WoW Forever 1.60.1.70425)

bootstrap_ignition_sequence.phase_label: IGNITION STEP 1: The Backbone Skinner Pioneer (Starter Sub-Zone -> Lv 6-7)
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.active_character_slot: Slot 3: THE ARMOR KIT & QUIVER ARTISAN
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.character_class_and_profs: Hunter (Skinning at Lv 2-3 + Leatherworking at Lv 5)
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.profession_unlock_action: At Lv 1 you have 0 copper. Quest 1->3 in starter valley (12 mins) to loot ~1.5 Silver. Walk to first town (Goldshire/Razor Hill/Kharanos/Dolanaar) at Lv 3, buy Skinning Knife (82c) + train Skinning (10c, NO level 5 requirement!). Grind beasts + starter quests to Lv 6-7 (Skinning hits ~45-60). Run to Capital City at Lv 5-6 to train Apprentice Leatherworking (10c) & Cooking.
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.seventy_percent_guild_stash: Keep 70% of Light Leather (~35x), Ruined Leather Scraps, Linen Cloth (~20x), and craft 4x Light Armor Kits (+8 Armor) + 3-4x Embossed Leather Vests / Handstitched Leather Belts (BoE LW Greens!). Mail these + 8 Silver seed coin to Slot 1 (The Royal Banker).
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.thirty_percent_ah_liquidation: Post 30% of haul on the Capital City AH: 1-2 stacks of Light Leather + 2x Light Armor Kits. Generates your first 15-30 Silver in steady liquid cash while you log onto the next toon!
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.why_this_exact_order_math: Starting with the Hunter Skinner to Lv 6-7 solves the 'Zero-Copper & Level-5 Gate Paradox': Skinning unlocks before Lv 5, beasts drop the highest vendor gray value per kill, and by Lv 7 your Hunter funds the Banker's training AND crafts the exact Lv 5 Leatherworking BoE Greens the Banker needs to Disenchant!

bootstrap_ignition_sequence.phase_label: IGNITION STEP 2: The Royal Banker & AH Sovereign (Lv 1 -> Lv 5 Capital City Lock-In)
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.active_character_slot: Slot 1: THE ROYAL BANKER & AH SOVEREIGN
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.profession_unlock_action: Power-level 1->5 in starter valley (22 mins), then immediately run to the Capital City (Stormwind/Ironforge or Orgrimmar/Thunder Bluff). Open the Hunter's mail (8 Silver + LW Greens + Linen + Light Armor Kits). Train Apprentice Enchanting (10c) + Apprentice Alchemy (10c) right at Level 5!
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.seventy_percent_guild_stash: Disenchant the Hunter's crafted LW Greens at Enchanting Skill 1 -> yields Strange Dust + Lesser Magic Essence! Craft Runed Copper Rod (once Blacksmith sends Inert Copper Rod in Step 3) + Novice's Practice Wand / Lesser Magic Wand (Lv 5, 11.3 DPS!). Park Banker at Capital City AH/Bank/Mailbox.
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.thirty_percent_ah_liquidation: List 30% of surplus Strange Dust or 1x Lesser Magic Wand on AH (sells for 8-15 Silver to caster mains!). Register Guild Charter at Guild Master.
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.why_this_exact_order_math: Getting the Banker to Level 5 second unlocks Apprentice Enchanting (Skill 1-75) + Disenchanting + Apprentice Alchemy (Skill 1-75) BEFORE the rest of the alt army generates hundreds of items, turning the Banker into an active factory instead of a passive mule.

bootstrap_ignition_sequence.phase_label: IGNITION STEP 3: The Forge & Rod Titan (Lv 1 -> Lv 6 Mining + Blacksmithing)
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.character_class_and_profs: Paladin or Warrior (Mining at Lv 2-3 + Blacksmithing at Lv 5)
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.profession_unlock_action: Open Banker Care Package (Light Armor Kits + 2 Silver). Buy Mining Pick (81c) + learn Mining at Lv 2-3. Mine Copper Veins along starter ridge to Lv 6 (Mining hits ~35). Run to Capital City at Lv 5-6, learn Blacksmithing, smelt Copper Bars, craft Rough Sharpening Stones (hits BS Skill 15), and craft INERT COPPER RODS (1x Rough Grinding Stone + 5x Copper Bar)!
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.seventy_percent_guild_stash: Keep 70% of Copper Bars/Rough Stones; mail 1x Inert Copper Rod + Copper Bars + BoE Greens to the Banker Enchanter, and mail Rough Sharpening Stones (+2 Weapon Dmg) to melee alts.
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.thirty_percent_ah_liquidation: List 30% on AH: 2-3x Inert Copper Rods (massive markup because every Enchanter on WoW Forever needs one from a Blacksmith!) + 1 stack of Copper Bars.
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.why_this_exact_order_math: Unlocks the Banker's Runed Copper Rod at BS Skill 15 so the Banker can immediately enchant Tier 1 White Heirlooms and craft Lesser Magic Wands!

bootstrap_ignition_sequence.phase_label: IGNITION STEP 4: The Bag & Cloth Baron (Lv 1 -> Lv 7 Tailoring + Skinning)
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.character_class_and_profs: Mage (Tailoring at Lv 5 + Skinning at Lv 2)
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.profession_unlock_action: Equip the Banker's newly crafted Level 5 Lesser Magic Wand (11.3 DPS — 2-shots every starter mob!). Shred humanoid camps from Lv 1->7 for Linen Cloth. Run to Capital City at Lv 5-6, learn Tailoring, spin Bolts of Linen Cloth, and craft Linen Bags (6-slot) + WoW Forever Custom LINEN REAGENT BAGS (gray=65)!
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.seventy_percent_guild_stash: 70% Guild Allocation: Mail 3x Linen Bags + 1x Linen Reagent Bag to the Banker, Hunter, Paladin, and next alts, plus mail White Linen Robes/Brown Linen Vests (BoE Greens) to the Banker to Disenchant!
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.thirty_percent_ah_liquidation: 30% AH Liquidation: List Linen Bags and Custom Linen Reagent Bags on the AH for instant gold flow.
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.why_this_exact_order_math: Eliminates the 16-slot backpack bottleneck across the entire account on Day 1. Every alt after Step 4 starts with 3x Linen Bags + 1x Linen Reagent Bag (40-42 total slots!).

bootstrap_ignition_sequence.phase_label: IGNITION STEP 5: The Botanical Speedster (Lv 1 -> Lv 7 Herbalism + Mining)
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.profession_unlock_action: Opens 4-Bag Care Package from Tailor + Light Armor Kits from Hunter. Learns Herbalism + Mining at Lv 2-3 (Tauren starts at 16 Herbalism!). Sweeps starter & border zones for Peacebloom, Silverleaf, Earthroot, Mageroyal, and Copper Ore to Lv 7.
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.seventy_percent_guild_stash: 70% Guild Allocation: Mail 50+ Peacebloom/Silverleaf/Earthroot to the Level 5 Banker Alchemist to brew Elixir of Lion's Strength, Elixir of Minor Fortitude, Minor Healing Potions, and Minor Mana Potions!
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.thirty_percent_ah_liquidation: 30% AH Liquidation: Sell 30% of raw herbs + surplus Minor Healing/Mana Potions on AH.
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.why_this_exact_order_math: Fuels the Banker Alchemist to hit Alchemy Skill 60+, unlocking Elixir of Minor Strength & Minor Mana Potions—which the Hunter LW needs to craft Forceful & Mystic Medium Armor Kits in Band 2!

bootstrap_ignition_sequence.phase_label: IGNITION STEP 6: Complete Band 1 Sweep Across Remaining Alts (Lv 1 -> Lv 6-7)
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.profession_unlock_action: Every remaining alt logs in to a mailbox overflowing with: 3x Linen Bags + 1x Linen Reagent Bag (40 slots!), 4x Light Armor Kits, Enchanted Tier 1 White Heirlooms (+15 HP Chest, +Weapon Dmg / Lesser Magic Wand), and Strength/Fortitude Elixirs! Each alt breezes from Lv 1->7 in ~25 mins and visits the Capital City at Lv 5 to start accumulating Rested XP.
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.seventy_percent_guild_stash: 70% of all Linen, Light Leather, Copper Ore, Rough Stone, Herbs, and Locked Chests flow into the Banker & Rogue Engineer.
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.thirty_percent_ah_liquidation: 30% of all gathered commodities & Portable Reagent Bots (Engineering gray=25) hit the AH.
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.why_this_exact_order_math: Parking all alts at a Capital City Inn at Level 6-7 activates the 150% Rested XP multiplier across your entire 10-character army!

bootstrap_ignition_sequence.phase_label: BAND 2 LOCKSTEP RELAY: Banker Lv 5 -> Lv 10 + Roster Lv 7 -> Lv 14
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.active_character_slot: Banker to Lv 10 FIRST, then Roster in Rested XP Rotation
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.profession_unlock_action: Wait until Banker has Rested XP -> push Banker from Lv 5 -> Lv 10 (takes ~35 mins with Enchanted Wand + Heirlooms) so Banker unlocks JOURNEYMAN ENCHANTING & ALCHEMY (Skill 75->150)! Now the Banker can Disenchant ALL Lv 10-25 Greens (Skill 25-75) and brew Elixir of Giant Growth & Lesser Mana Potions!
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.seventy_percent_guild_stash: 70% Guild Allocation: Hunter crafts 4x Forceful Medium Armor Kits & 4x Mystic Medium Armor Kits (using Banker's Strange Dust + Elixirs/Potions); Tailor crafts 8-slot Woolen Bags + Woolen Reagent Bags; Banker crafts Greater Magic Wands (Lv 13, 17.5 DPS!).
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.thirty_percent_ah_liquidation: 30% AH Liquidation: Post Forceful/Mystic Medium Armor Kits, Woolen Reagent Bags, Greater Magic Wands, and Inert Silver Rods.
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.why_this_exact_order_math: Pushing the Banker to Lv 10 right as the roster enters Band 2 prevents the Disenchanting & Profession Cap bottleneck (`Skill 75 limit`) so no crafted Leatherworking or Tailoring green ever sits un-disenchanted!

bootstrap_ignition_sequence.phase_label: BAND 3 & 4 LOCKSTEP RELAY: Banker to Lv 20 (Expert 225) -> Lv 35 (Artisan 300)
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.active_character_slot: Banker to Lv 20 at Roster Lv 18; Banker to Lv 35 at Roster Lv 32
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.profession_unlock_action: Keep the Golden Rule of Banker Progression: Unlock Lv 10 Banker when Roster hits Lv 8; Unlock Lv 20 Banker (plus Mage Teleport!) when Roster hits Lv 18; Unlock Lv 35 Banker (Artisan 300 Max Cap!) when Roster hits Lv 32.
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.seventy_percent_guild_stash: 70% funds Silk/Mageweave/Runecloth Reagent Bags, Forceful/Mystic Heavy/Thick/Rugged Armor Kits, Portable Repair Bots & Arcane Salvagers, and Level 40 Mounts.
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.thirty_percent_ah_liquidation: 30% of all Transmutes, Mooncloth CDs, Bags, Armor Kits, and Elixirs sold on AH.
bootstrap_ignition_sequence.why_this_exact_order_math: In WoW Classic/Forever, Level 35 is the FINAL character level requirement for 300 Artisan professions. Once your Banker hits Level 35, it never needs another XP point to craft 100% of endgame Level 60 Enchants, Flasks, and Transmutes!

character_analyzer_formula.module_title: Hybrid Auto-Scanner (Account-Wide SavedVariables) + 1-Click Planned Alt Registration
character_analyzer_formula.detection_or_math_formula: Lua Engine Hook: On PLAYER_LOGIN / PLAYER_LEVEL_UP / SKILL_LINES_CHANGED / BAG_UPDATE / MAIL_SHOW, write character snapshot to Account-Wide SavedVariables `AltVaultDB.characters[realm][charName]` = {level, class, race, xp, maxXP, restedXP, moneyCopper, prof1={name,skill,max}, prof2={name,skill,max}, bagFreeSlots, reagentBagEquipped, armorKitsActive, zone, isBanker}. PLUS UI Input Field `AltVaultDB.plannedRoster` allowing player to type or select planned alt names/classes before even logging into them!
character_analyzer_formula.mode_a_solo_main_behavior: Scans the active Single Main character's exact Level, Talent Points, Equipped Gear, Professions, and Current Zone.
character_analyzer_formula.mode_b_multi_alt_empire_behavior: Automatically aggregates all logged alts + any manually entered Planned Alts into a unified 10-Slot Royal Guild Dashboard without needing external scripts.
character_analyzer_formula.ui_actionable_recommendation: Displays live status badges: [LOGGED & SYNCED], [RESTED 150% CAP!], [PROFESSION CAP GATE REACHED], or [PLANNED ALT - LOG IN TO INITIALIZE].

character_analyzer_formula.module_title: The Mathematical 'Who Do I Level Next & For How Long?' Relay Formula
character_analyzer_formula.detection_or_math_formula: NextAltPriorityScore(c) = (W_Bootstrap * BootstrapGateUrgency(c)) + (W_Banker * BankerCapBottleneck(c)) + (W_Rested * (RestedXP_Pct(c) / 150.0) * 35.0) + (W_BandLag * max(0, AvgRosterLevel - Level(c)) * 8.0) + (W_Supply * GuildMaterialStarvationWeight(c) * 25.0)
character_analyzer_formula.mode_a_solo_main_behavior: In Solo Main Mode: Sets target milestone to the next Talent Spike Level (Phase 2), Gear/Quest Acquisition Milestone (Phase 4), or Profession Bracket Unlock (+5/10/20/35).
character_analyzer_formula.mode_b_multi_alt_empire_behavior: In Multi-Alt Empire Mode: Evaluates all characters using `NextAltPriorityScore(c)` and highlights the #1 highest-scoring toon, telling the player: 'Log onto [Character Name] next and level from Lv X -> Lv Y (~Z mins) to unlock [Exact Milestone]!'
character_analyzer_formula.ui_actionable_recommendation: Renders a glowing 'RECOMMENDED NEXT SESSION' banner with exact start level, stop level, estimated time, and why (e.g., 'Level Hunter 1->7 first to seed 15s + Light Leather + LW Greens for Banker!').

character_analyzer_formula.detection_or_math_formula: BankerReadyStatus = Check(Banker.EnchantingSkill >= RequiredDESkill(MaxCraftedGreeniLvl(Roster))) AND Check(Banker.Level >= RequiredProfTierLevel(MaxRosterLevel)). Thresholds: Roster Lv 1-9 -> Banker Lv 5 (Skill 75); Roster Lv 10-19 -> Banker Lv 10 (Skill 150); Roster Lv 20-31 -> Banker Lv 20 (Skill 225); Roster Lv 32-60 -> Banker Lv 35 (Skill 300).
character_analyzer_formula.mode_a_solo_main_behavior: In Solo Mode: Checks if the player's own professions are lagging behind their current zone's node requirements (e.g., entering a Briarthorn/Tin zone with <50/65 skill).
character_analyzer_formula.mode_b_multi_alt_empire_behavior: In Multi-Alt Mode: Immediately triggers a HIGH PRIORITY alert if any alt is about to craft or loot iLvl greens that exceed the Banker's current Enchanting/Alchemy tier cap!
character_analyzer_formula.ui_actionable_recommendation: Advises: 'STOP! Before crafting Fine/Dark Leather greens on your Hunter, push your Banker from Lv 5 -> Lv 10 (22 mins rested) or craft 10x Runed Copper Bracers to hit Enchanting 25/50!'

character_analyzer_formula.module_title: Real-Time 70% Guild Reinvestment / 30% Auction House Split Advisor
character_analyzer_formula.detection_or_math_formula: For each gathered/crafted item `i` in Bags/Bank: GuildNeed(i) = Sum(RecipeReagentsNeededForNextBand(Roster, i)); RetainQty(i) = max(GuildNeed(i), floor(0.70 * TotalCount(i))); SellOnAHQty(i) = ceil(0.30 * TotalCount(i)) converted into HighestMarginProduct(i) from `wow_forever_ah_30_70_liquidity_ledger`.
character_analyzer_formula.mode_a_solo_main_behavior: In Solo Mode: Recommends selling 100% of non-class materials and reinvesting into the best AH BoE upgrades & mounts.
character_analyzer_formula.mode_b_multi_alt_empire_behavior: In Multi-Alt Mode: Splits every farming haul at the mailbox into two exact lists: (A) [MAIL TO GUILD CRAFTER / BANKER (70%)] and (B) [POST ON AUCTION HOUSE (30%)] in the highest-profit form (e.g., turn 30% of Light Leather + Dust + Elixirs into Forceful Armor Kits for AH!).
character_analyzer_formula.ui_actionable_recommendation: When opening a Mailbox or Auction House, displays a clean checklist: 'Mail 28x Light Leather to Hunter | Convert 12x into 3x Forceful Kits & Post on AH for ~45s!'
